about: THE REFLECTION SCOPE BY NAME (kit 0.14.3, deep review KIT-2, invariant 192) — ONE rule, run by BOTH sides: a `call` or `set` whose target (the second word) is spelled in the runtime's or the engine's namespaces cannot be ticked, except the few engine members a shot legitimately writes. The kit: ReflectionScope.NameRefusal, asked by Levers.NotTickableReason (so TickList refuses a list holding one, whole) — RunnerScopeSharedCasesTests. The website: shots-lint.ts placeholderFirst (so the tick list's sender drops such a row, one at a time, and a shot holding one is an error) and lane-shots.ts BLOCKED_RUNNER_NAMESPACES — runner-scope.spec.ts. A namespace matches the whole target, or its start followed by '.' or '+'. The kit ALSO refuses, at every tick and every run, a type that RESOLVES outside the game's player assemblies (a bare `Process.Start`) — that half needs the editor's types and is the kit's alone; the cases below marked kitResolvedOnly are fine BY NAME and refused only there.

cases.kitResolvedOnly: resolves to UnityEngine.Time — an engine member the kit allows
resolves to System.Diagnostics.Process — refused by the kit's resolved half

cases.why: a game namespace that only STARTS with 'Unity' letters is not 'Unity'
a read — the scope judges call and set only
not a call/set: a console command the game's own runner resolves
